question: Does removing only reference-side v/u spelling distinction impair exact original-spelling recovery on a fresh historical work under an unchanged mixed decoder?
reference: All UDante Monarchia sentences; identical sentence/token order in both arms, COLLAPSED replaces v by u in reference words only
control: UDante De vulgari eloquentia Book I discovery, Book II held; all citation-run paragraphs and vernacular quotations retained
candidate_policy: One common pool from NATIVE reference only; unchanged GDT832 letter alphabet, suffix candidates, wholeword candidate rule and encoder value decks
family_policy: Empty family resource and zero family coefficient in both conditions; GDT832's failed family-gain claim is not reopened

optimizer.selection: highest discovery objective; ties lowest start
optimizer.initialization: Unchanged GDT832 frequency initialization uses its respective reference. Seeds/budgets/candidates are paired; initial keys need not coincide. The oracle contrast separately isolates objective direction.

capacity.unused_parameters: Unobserved in both partitions means unidentifiable and unscored from the outset; no post-capacity gate adjustment

specific_effect.oracle_mutant: One legal bijective key formed by swapping the complete outputs of the true v and z literal carriers; all other values unchanged
specific_effect.oracle_score: truth minus the legal v/z-swap discovery objective, evaluated only after all fits are locked

evaluation.gold: Exact original normalized control spelling; never v/u-collapsed
evaluation.word_accuracy: exact matched word occurrences / all applicable occurrences
evaluation.character_accuracy: 1 - sum wordwise Levenshtein distances / sum max(gold length, predicted length); known spaces excluded
evaluation.novelty: Against original discovery plaintext, composed L/S words only; lemma joins must be unambiguous
evaluation.replicates: Three encryption keys share one source split; no independent-content or population-p-value claim

blinding: All 48 restarts and six discovery-selected keys hash-locked before evaluator key-truth or held recovery access
claim_ceiling: A reference intervention on a fresh historical control with known boundaries and role classes. No rerun or repaired score of GDT832, no full paradigm inference, no Voynich fit, language or translation.
